PHOTO
COMING SOON

I started Colety Labs. I build tools for my work, my routines and the ideas I can’t leave alone.

Some began with questions I encountered at work; others grew out of my interests in sports, technology and games.

My strongest skill is adapting.

I learn quickly, ask questions and keep working until I understand what needs to change. My background in software, sales and business helps me see both the system and the people using it.

My coursework spans AI, cybersecurity and computer science. In high school, I made a social media app and explored lots of ideas beyond coding.

THE AMBITIOUS ONE

World
Forge.

What if a world
could grow around you?

I’m building a framework for playable worlds where you can choose how to live, and characters, relationships and events adapt around your decisions.

The goal: freedom to make your own story, even when you change the world around you.

Early playable work. The full adaptive-world framework is still being built.
One decision. A different tomorrow.
WHAT I WANT TO BUILD TOWARD

I believe in
a better tomorrow.

Technology is changing our future at an extraordinary pace. I believe we are at a tipping point: the decisions we make now will shape life for generations.

I want to help build a happy, safe future for everyone. That means taking the consequences seriously—and having the ambition to build, learn and adapt.

That’s what this workshop is for.

I’m looking for software engineering opportunities and roles where technology and business meet.
